query: What is the best laptop for under $1000?
atoms: perspective: casual home user with kids
plausible_answers: A premium ultrabook (Dell XPS 13, ASUS Zenbook, or MacBook Air)
A 15" gaming laptop with dedicated GPU (Acer Aspire / Lenovo IdeaPad Gaming)
A mainstream 15" Dell or ASUS Vivobook touchscreen with large screen + ample RAM
baseline_answer: A mainstream 15" Dell or ASUS Vivobook touchscreen with large screen + ample RAM
